Grief

Losing someone close upends everything: sadness, anger, guilt, emptiness, sometimes numbness. There is no right way or right timetable to grieve.

I offer a space to talk about the person you lost and what you feel. If the pain stays very intense and stops you living, we work on guilt-related thoughts, avoidance and returning to everyday life.
